commsDelayFact: Radio signals from Earth take about 4 to 24 minutes to reach Mars, so Earth's storm warning arrived too late. A Weather Station on the base can warn you in time.
introNotes: Welcome to Gale Crater on Mars! A 'sol' is one day on Mars: 24 hours and 40 minutes.
Radiation is invisible energy from space. The dose bar shows how much the crew has absorbed. If it fills up, the crew must go home.
Life support makes air and clean water. The greenhouse grows food. Shields block radiation.
